usedFor: Shopify processes orders and pushover alerts your phone, so “Order Cancelled” can feed “Send a Pushover Notification”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send a Pushover Notification” in pushover
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order shows up on your subscribed devices instead of waiting in an inbox.

watchOut: “Creating a Group” makes a Pushover group, so keep it off “Order Cancelled” or every cancellation adds a group.
